semiconductor_relevance: High — ASUZAC manufactures fine ceramic components specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, making them a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: ASUZAC specializes in the production of fine ceramic components, including transport hands, stages, and trays, primarily made from alumina and SiC. Their products are designed to enhance semiconductor manufacturing processes through features like outgassing prevention and precision wafer handling.
capabilities: Manufacturing of transport hands with integrated sensors for temperature control
Production of porous and hole/pin chucks for high-precision wafer suction
Development of specialized alumina materials with enhanced conductivity and wear resistance
